order_note: Predecessor SQL 130 (aws/workflows/sql/130_financial_totp_rate_limit_code_check_no_public.sql, applied to staging and production on 2026-10-30): the inspect reports predecessors.sql130 true only while consume_financial_totp_rate_limit(uuid, text, integer, integer) is in SQL 130's intended state, which it is in both databases. SQL 131 does not read or change that function; the predecessor records the order the owner chose (SQL 130 first, then SQL 131: 'restart SQL 131 and the lockout fix', 2026-10-30). SQL 131 sets only the EXECUTE ACL of the four financial TOTP enrollment functions created on the AWS databases from aws/migrations/proposed/NOT_APPLIED_20260911_financial_totp_enrollment.sql (on no release key): financial_totp_upsert_enrollment(uuid, bytea, bytea, text), financial_totp_get_enrollment(uuid), financial_totp_mark_verified(uuid, bigint) and financial_totp_status(uuid). Production (read-only financial TOTP live inspect 2026-10-30, SSM cfee4512-4988-4fd1-be77-b03d1b4cd50b) holds EXECUTE for PUBLIC, checksops and the owner on each; the file revokes PUBLIC and grants checksops (already granted), so the ACL after is checksops and the owner. Each function must exist and be owned by the applying login (acl_functions_present, acl_functions_owned_by_login) and hold no EXECUTE entry other than checksops and the owner, which the file keeps, and PUBLIC, which it revokes, each granted by the owner (acl_functions_acl_replaceable). The only callers are the API Lambda (aws/functions/api/auth-financial-totp.mjs: all four; providers/production/checkalt-register.mjs: get_enrollment and mark_verified), which connects as checksops (data.mjs withIdentity, db-health.mjs EXPECTED_APPLICATION_ROLE checksops), so no caller loses access; no SQL function, view, policy or trigger calls them. No API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin. Adds no trigger.

tooling.note: Guarded tooling for SQL 131: sql131-financial-totp-functions-no-public-production-apply.mjs --inspect (read-only) and the receipt-gated --apply on the engine shared with the staging guarded executor (choice sql131-financial-totp-functions-no-public); production-sql-one-shot.mjs --migration sql131. intended_replacement_sha256 is the code-derived fingerprint (releaseIntendedHash in release-sql-state.mjs, equal to the staging pin's): the four functions' EXECUTE ACLs with grantors (spec acl_functions, render.grantors, no attributes), checksops and the owner on each. The post-conditions also require each function's body, attributes and owner unchanged (acl_functions_otherwise_unchanged). The tooling does not authorize anything: this pin stays execute false until a reviewed change records the staging acceptance, the production inspect and an owner approval.
